mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth remains above 2% without corresponding tightening in monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with positive HOUST growth, or HOUST growth does not correlate with GDP growth (GDPC1) over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wages and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased consumer spending (RSAFS).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with GDP growth (GDPC1) over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% MoM AND UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with increased consumer confidence indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which boosts equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with increased market liquidity.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS growth does not correlate with increased consumer spending (RSAFS).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.
